definition: First market bar eligible for forward validation
notes: catchup bars after this timestamp remain valid forward observations
derivation: Last phase=warmup event in events.csv closed at 2026-08-28T00:00:00Z (market_ts_ms=1787875200000); the next 1h bar, 2026-08-28T01:00:00Z, is the first bar processed after the initial bootstrap warmup completed and is the true forward-epoch boundary.
do_not_use: state.json's epoch_start_iso field (2026-08-28T00:47:13Z at initial deployment) is PROCESS CONSTRUCTION WALL-CLOCK TIME, not a market-bar boundary. It must never be used to filter events.csv/trades.csv by market time -- use forward_epoch_start_ts_ms in this file instead.
